---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Agneax OS
title: "[FEATURE] Brief title of suggestion"
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Example: "I find it inconvenient when..."

**Describe the Solution You Would Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen or how you imagine the feature working.

**Module / Component**
Which part of Agneax OS does this request affect?
- [ ] Agneax Desktop / Dock / Status Bar
- [ ] Agneax UI Appearance / Themes
- [ ] File Manager
- [ ] System Settings
- [ ] Terminal
- [ ] System Updater / Package Installer
- [ ] Multimedia Apps (Image Viewer, Video Player, Camera)
- [ ] Other: [Specify]

**Describe Alternatives You Have Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

**Mockups or Examples**
If applicable, add sketches, mockups, or screenshots from other platforms demonstrating your idea.
